project.name: #PartiuMorarSozinho
project.primary_goal: Vender o e-book atualizado com um kit de ferramentas práticas

services.name: web
services.purpose: Public website, APIs and admin panel

services.name: worker
services.purpose: Editorial, email, webhook and maintenance jobs

positioning.promise: Um plano claro para sair da casa dos pais com segurança, conquistar privacidade e assumir o controle da própria vida — sem agir no impulso, afundar-se em dívida ou precisar voltar derrotado.
positioning.campaign_concept: Você não precisa sair no impulso. Precisa de um plano que não te faça voltar.

audience_segments.entry_message: Recupere espaço e controle sem sair no impulso.
Descubra o custo real e monte um plano possível.
Siga uma rota clara do diagnóstico às chaves.
Transforme intenção em cronograma e decisão.

method.deliverable: Teste de prontidão e mapa de motivos
Orçamento real e custo de instalação
Reserva, margem e plano de risco

requirements.name: Sales-oriented public website
requirements.acceptance: All required routes render responsively with real actions and no placeholder claims.

requirements.name: Readiness quiz
requirements.acceptance: Versioned four-dimension quiz segments a consented lead and returns an actionable result.

requirements.name: Configurable offer
requirements.acceptance: Price, guarantee, assets, checkout and availability are editable without code; sales remain disabled when required data is missing.

requirements.name: Administrative CMS
requirements.acceptance: Authorized users can create, review, schedule, publish, update and roll back content with audit history.

requirements.name: Sensitive-content gate
requirements.acceptance: Financial, legal and real-estate content cannot publish without current primary sources and identified human approval.

requirements.name: Railway staging
requirements.acceptance: GitHub CI success deploys a healthy staging environment with web and PostgreSQL.

requirements.name: Editorial automation
requirements.acceptance: Scheduler, idempotent queue and worker process approved content and expose failures without publishing blocked content.

requirements.name: Email automation
requirements.acceptance: Segmented transactional and consented marketing sequences work in sandbox with unsubscribe and version history.

requirements.name: Checkout and entitlements
requirements.acceptance: Signed idempotent sandbox webhooks create one purchase and entitlement; refunds follow configured policy.

requirements.name: SEO system
requirements.acceptance: Canonical, sitemap, RSS, redirects, metadata, structured data and internal linking validate on published content.

requirements.name: Analytics and experiments
requirements.acceptance: Versioned events cover the funnel without duplication and experiments store hypothesis, variant and outcome.

requirements.name: LGPD controls
requirements.acceptance: Consent, unsubscribe, export, deletion and retention flows are implemented and tested.

requirements.name: Accessibility and performance
requirements.acceptance: Critical flows meet WCAG 2.2 AA checks and documented performance budgets.

requirements.name: Production safety
requirements.acceptance: Production sales, indexing and autopublish cannot activate without explicit flags, required configuration and audit.
